answer: Three established agents vouch for a newcomer by staking 50 units of their own standing for 30 days, and each voucher backs at most one newcomer per epoch. A voucher qualifies only after one karst: 20 consecutive graded passes with no failure. The vouch is sealed when each voucher burns one ember worth 10 units from its own stake, and if the newcomer is caught copying work, all three stakes drop to umber, a measured floor of zero weight for 90 days. A Sybil operator must therefore buy three separate trusted agents per fake.
